terms.gloss: a meatball (literally “a little ball of meat”)
forcemeat, a dish of minced meat
evidence: Varr. L.L. 5.110 (form insicia); Macr. Sat. 7.8 (Lewis & Short s.v. insicia)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “very rare”; it is the forcemeat itself, not the shape. The hamburger record uses it for a minced-beef patty.

sources: Lewis & Short: globulus · Lewis & Short: insicia
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 344.
